The mailer fill task achieved a perfect reward score by successfully passing the legacy pytest suite in a single trial.
The run achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.87, with the reward_change showing an improvement from 0.00. The command `test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite` passed in 0.11 seconds with zero exceptions across all trials. Results were successfully serialized to result.json at the specified experiment path, confirming the stability of the current mailer fill logic.
